signatures.description: Implement an MVCC storage engine that compacts range tombstones and point versions while preserving snapshot reads, including snapshots that begin or end during compaction. The compactor must be crash-safe, bounded-memory, and produce identical query results under adversarial overlapping tombstones and version chains.
